CatalogRef.description: How any response points at a Catalog item (ADR 0006).
CatalogRef.title: CatalogRef

MealTotal.description:
A foods Meal's calories and macros, by the same rules as a Day Total (ADR 0023).

A Restaurant Meal has none: its Day counts as the User's flat value, and no part of that
belongs to one Meal.
MealTotal.title: MealTotal

Nutrition.description:
What a label prints: calories and macros for a Basis amount in grams (ADR 0023).

One object, not five fields on the Food: the five are all set or all absent, and a
nullable object says that in the schema itself. A partial one fails as a missing field.
Nutrition.title: Nutrition

ReferenceFood.description: Shaped like a Food's own fields, so "Fill from reference" copies them straight across.
ReferenceFood.title: ReferenceFood
